entities.summary: María del Pilar Mañas Brugat is a Spanish military officer. In 2017 she became the first woman to take command of a Spanish Air Force unit. She was named an Exemplary Woman by the Women's Institute in 2018. In 2022 she was awarded the Operation Balmis Commemorative Medal.

entities.summary: María del Pilar Mañas Brugat is a Spanish military officer. In 2017 she became the first woman to take command of a Spanish Air Force unit. She was named an Exemplary Woman by the Women's Institute in 2018. In 2022 she was awarded the Operation Balmis Commemorative Medal.
